## What's New in Quote 2.0.0

* New onboarding on first launch: language, appearance, quote sources, daily reminder and author pictures
* Pick the reminder time with the Android clock dial
* 1,527 quotes, including about 190 new curated quotes with verified sources
* Every quote is available in German and English, with a translation toggle on each card
* Wikipedia portraits and short bios for authors (can be turned off in Settings)
* Quotes without an author are shown as "Unknown"
* Community quotes now respect the quote language, so German submissions reach German users
* Submissions: see why a quote was rejected, edit and resubmit it, or withdraw a pending one
* Fixed submissions getting stuck after a lost connection or a restored backup
* Community quotes refresh when you open the app instead of polling every minute
* Fixed missing closing quotation marks, cut-off German text and spacing in the library
* Sheets and dialogs use Material You colors, also in AMOLED mode
* The splash screen follows your themed icon colors
* Much smaller and faster app thanks to code shrinking and startup profiles
